change_summary: Clarify configured Workspace authority and separate finite-event recurrence from the durable value of a requested organized result without weakening safety boundaries.

canonical_skill.note: The shared Skill presents the configured Workspace as a bounded work surface and separates nonrecurring events from reader-artifact retention without forcing reusable Skills.

server_contract.note: The compatible 2026-09-09.8 wire contract exposes configured-Workspace authority and separates event recurrence, reader-artifact value, and reusable-Skill admission.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.21 with the compatible 2026-09-09.8 collaboration contract.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.23 remains compatible with the 2026-09-09.8 wire contract; this release does not change CLI bytes.

help_center.note: Existing multilingual MCP Help already covers natural delegation and canonical artifact URLs; no Help bytes change in 1.7.21.

package_setup.note: The existing Claude Plugin hook remains compatible; the revised event/result distinction is carried by the canonical Skill and server contract.

harness_and_mainline.note: The host-neutral 30 by 2 denominator remains unchanged; the Harness records configured-surface authority, separately freezes host-owned user guidance, and verifies host-native derived files independently from remote persistence.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; the two-host fresh acceptance matrix remains runtime evidence and WorkBuddy is outside this cycle.

release_evidence.note: Evidence covers Skill/package identity, separate host user-guidance identity, configured-Workspace task scope, ordinary-business transfer, exclusion-first no-call behavior, and the host-neutral portfolio.
